description: Behavioral temperature sensor plus 12-bit ADC front-end model for system integration.

fixed_assumptions: Model is idealized and intended for system integration.
Temperature input is provided as a 16-bit behavioral control stimulus in Celsius units.
ADC output is 12-bit unsigned and clamped to the range 0 to 4095.
A simple linear transfer function maps temperature to ADC code.
A request on sample_req initiates a conversion response after a small behavioral latency.
Parameters shall exist for gain error, offset error, and nominal sample latency.
Analog supply pins avdd and avss are included as interface context signals.

functionality: Accepts a temperature stimulus and a sample request, then produces a clamped 12-bit ADC code derived from a linear temperature transfer function. The block asserts adc_valid when the sampled result is available and holds the converted code until a subsequent conversion updates it. The model is deterministic and intended to approximate sensor plus ADC front-end behavior for SoC integration and correlation planning.
responsibilities: Convert sensor_temp_celsius into a 12-bit digital code using a linear mapping.
Apply gain error and offset error parameters to the ideal transfer function.
Clamp the computed code to the legal 12-bit range.
Assert adc_valid when the conversion result becomes available.
Hold adc_code constant between conversion updates.
Provide a simple latency abstraction using a nominal sample latency parameter.
Expose interface context through avdd and avss pins.
reset_behavior: No dedicated reset signal is specified. On model initialization, adc_valid shall be deasserted and adc_code shall initialize to 0. If sample_req is not asserted, the outputs remain at their last driven state, with adc_valid deasserted until a conversion completes.
behavior_rules: Use a deterministic linear transfer function from temperature to code.
Include parameter hooks for gain error, offset error, and nominal sample latency.
Saturate the final code to 12-bit unsigned range.
Assert adc_valid only when converted output data is available.
Retain the last converted adc_code until overwritten by a new conversion.
Do not modify outputs in response to avdd and avss in this simplified behavioral model.
Treat sample_req as the sole conversion request control.

input_to_output_relations: sample_req initiates a delayed update of adc_code and adc_valid.
sensor_temp_celsius maps linearly to adc_code with gain and offset error adjustments.
avdd and avss are observed as interface context signals.
output_update_rules: Update adc_code only when the conversion response is due.
Assert adc_valid when the updated adc_code is presented.
Deassert adc_valid when no conversion result is being presented.
error_conditions: Computed code below 0 shall be saturated to 0.
Computed code above 4095 shall be saturated to 4095.
latency_rules: Conversion output shall be delayed by the nominal sample latency parameter after sample_req assertion.
timing_rules: Behavior is synchronous to the internal behavioral timing abstraction defined by the model.
No combinational change of adc_code is permitted directly on sample_req assertion.
adc_valid shall not assert before the modeled latency elapses.
